steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Do you come from the Court of Sargon?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: That was my previous employment.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Never thought you'd be able to identify Sargon swordsmanship.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I have little interest in Arts. But when it comes to weaponry, I couldn't forget anything, even if I wanted to.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: No wonder they called The Black Knight a natural-born warrior.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Natural-born?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Do you know how long it took to go from 'a Leithanian who can't use Arts' to 'a natural-born warrior?'

a.text: The shield in Sharp's hand reveals a crack.
Though there are several wounds on Degenbrecher's body, she seems not to notice them.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Do you have no sense of pain?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: If growing up, the only waking sensation you knew was pain, then you too would be used to it.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: How about you? How many times have you danced with death?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Everyone I knew who even thought of counting didn't survive long in battle.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I heard that The Black Knight, despite being a three-time champion, was exiled from Kazimierz and hunted for refusing to work with the General Chamber of Commerce, eventually disappearing beyond Kazimierz's borders.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: So?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Once a symbol of refusal to bow to authority, now a conspirator's bodyguard taking part in the usurpation of a country.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I don't pass any moral judgments. I just can't help but to feel a bit let down.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I thought a Rhodes Islander of all people would understand Enciodes's ideas.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Understanding is one thing. Acceptance is another.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Actually, I think the Doctor understands Enciodes well.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'm not going to defend Enciodes or myself. It's too much of a hassle, and also unnecessary.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: See for yourself what he wants with your own eyes – if you survive, that is.
After a great many struggles, Ensia finally reaches the edge of the cliff. She can scale it easily, but the sound of a nearby conversation makes her freeze.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior A
steps.text: Everything's gone to shit down there, and everything's gone to shit up here too.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior B
steps.text: Yeah. I can't believe the Great Elder went down like that, and now Arctosz is rampaging his way up here.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior A
steps.text: I was under the assumption that the worst was over, but now I have no idea what's going to happen next.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior B
steps.text: I didn't really think there'd be peace anyway, but now that things have gone south, I feel a little guilty.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior A
steps.text: Guilty? Why?

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior B
steps.text: Since we entered the Vine-Bead Court, the Lady–– Err, the Saintess, has clearly taken the reins.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior B
steps.text: Since the Great Elder collapsed, the entire Vine-Bead Court has fallen in line with the Saintess.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior B
steps.text: And below the mountain, Sir Enciodes has taken complete control.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior A
steps.text: When you put it that way, it all makes sense, huh. The Saintess controls the mountain, and Sir Enciodes controls everything below.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior B
steps.text: Borrowing your words, I have no idea what's going to happen next.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior A
steps.text: We're just underlings anyway. There's no point thinking too hard about it.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior B
steps.text: Yeah, you're right. Why even bother?

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior B
steps.text: Let's make two more rounds. Maybe we'll get called down the mountain by then.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Sis...

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior C
steps.text: Hey! What's that?!

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior D
steps.text: The granary is on fire!

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior C
steps.text: What?! Someone go put it out, hurry!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Heh, piece of cake.

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior
steps.text: Madame, you certainly have a unique way of doing things, though that's to be expected...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: The hell are you trying to say?!

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior
steps.text: N-Nothing, it was a compliment.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmph. I'll pay for them to rebuild the granary after we're all done here, but for now, we're on urgent business!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Stop dragging your feet! The fire's got their attention, so go rescue Yucatan! The place is right ahead!

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior
steps.text: Yes, Madame!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...Kjarr.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I'm here, Saintess.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: During the ceremony, I recall that when I happened to spot you in the crowd, there was a hooded figure next to you.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I've heard that this person is a guest from Rhodes Island invited by Enciodes. A guest known as the Doctor.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But now, that individual stands with Arctosz, fighting against Enciodes.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: ...Nothing escapes you, Saintess.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: How did you come to know this person?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: By chance, when I was heading down the mountain to deliver your letter.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...I'll take your word for it then.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Why did this question suddenly grip your thoughts?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I would like to meet this person.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Though I don't know exactly why, the Doctor stands in direct opposition to Enciodes.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I want to know exactly why.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I no longer doubt what I must do, but I am afraid that I made up my mind too late.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: There are some things I must fight for.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: About that... You needn't worry yourself.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Because the Doctor's emissary is right behind you.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Sis!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Ensia... I suppose I've finally started hallucinating.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Snap out of it, sis! You're not hallucinating! It's me, your sister, Ensia!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: What?! Ensia, is that really you?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: It is! Here, come touch me if you don't believe it.
Enya wants to reach out with her shaking hands to feel Ensia.
She fears that the sister who suddenly appeared before her is an illusion.
But before she has a chance to do so, Ensia has already plunged into her arms.
She knows right away, without a shadow of a doubt, that the woman embracing her is her dearest little sister.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It's you, Ensia... It really is you...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I've missed you so much.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I've missed you too.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Have you been well?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: What of your illness?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: What kind of place is this Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: You're so silly. You already asked all these things in your letters.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I have to tell you...
Sharp takes a few steps back with a shallow breath.
He has fought many opponents throughout his career, and has also learned from – or at least watched – many formidable fighters at Rhodes Island.
But he has to admit – he has never faced anyone like Degenbrecher before. Or rather, an opponent as pure and simple as Degenbrecher.
She has speed and strength, qualities that every warrior should possess.
Degenbrecher has nothing more, but clearly needs nothing more.
Why would anyone need anything more than incredible speed and strength?
Fortunately... Sharp became an elite operator because he also possesses these two things.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: You have a lot of trust in Enciodes.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: What makes you say that?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Few people have the capacity to do this for money.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: And besides, you are not a person who can be won over with money.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: What about you? You said this is just business, but what you've done goes well beyond duty.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I assure you, the work I do is the work I like.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...I didn't like Kazimierz. Too chaotic, and the people are too loud.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I thought I wouldn't like Kjerag either.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: But Kjerag isn't too bad.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: That's a fair reason. Having a nice place to retire is important.
As if reaching a tacit agreement, the two sides take a few steps back.
They both realize that their previous moves achieved nothing toward the goal of eliminating the opponent.
They would have to tap into more of their power.
Degenbrecher casts her sword aside, and pulls the swordbreakers from her waist.
Sharp likewise discards his shield and holds his knife with both hands.
An evergreen tree branch buckles under the weight of the snow with a crackling sound.
In the same instant, Sharp and Degenbrecher both vanish from where they were just a second ago.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Honestly, what am I going to do with you?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You actually managed to sneak past everyone and climb all the way up from the foot of the mountain.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Heheh, it was the only way for me to see you.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You were just saying a certain 'the Doctor' sent you up here?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: To what end?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: The Doctor told me I should stay by your side, protect you when you need it, or help you escape.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: When I need it?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Yeah, like if our brother tries to do something bad to you.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Okay, this is what I think.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: He has his ideas, and I can't stop him.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But if those ideas end up putting you in danger...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I'll put my life on the line to stop him.
Enya suddenly understands why the Doctor sent her sister to her side.
For protection. For a way out. These are the two reasons told to Ensia.
But the Doctor also knows about her ideals, as well as the fact that being able to see her sister would be inherently meaningful.
Have Ensia protect her?
Have Ensia help her escape?
No, quite the opposite.
She is the one who should protect Ensia.
She is the one who should help Ensia escape.
She is the one –– who should be fighting.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Ensia, I see you're still wearing the bracelet I made for you.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Of course. And I'll keep wearing it.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I'll find the time to make a new one for you.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Really?!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Mmhmm.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: So, Ensia...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Yeah?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Do you want to do a little favor for me?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: A favor?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Come with me.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (It's awfully quiet outside, but there should still be two guards.)

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (The window... If I don't want them to see me from this angle, I have to lead the guards away first.)

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (The patrol route... They pass through this area five times a day, and should be coming around soon.)

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (No, I can't force open the lock... But if I can pick it...)

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (...Then there might still be a chance.)

steps.name: Young Guard
steps.text: Sir Enciodes... This time I swear...

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (––They're coming!)

steps.name: Young Guard
steps.text: The conflict... three clans seems inevitable, but...

steps.name: Older Guard
steps.text: ...Browntail clan's... burning... Sciurus...

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (Sciurus...?!)

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (Why did they mention Rus? Did something happen to her?!)

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (Dammit, I'm still too far away... I can't hear clearly.)

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (No, she can handle herself. I have to find a way out of here first, then find Sciurus and the Matriarch...)

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: Halt, who are you people?!

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: Stop them right now–– Guh...

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (There's a commotion coming from the entrance... What happened?)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yucatan, are you alright?!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Rus?! What are you doing here?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Huh? Are you dumb? I'm here for you, obviously!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Everyone else is so worthless, I had to rescue you myself!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: But, it's too dangerous!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Rus, how many did you bring with you? Y-You didn't have to come yourself, you know. I wouldn't want anything to happen to you!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yucatan.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Say one more word and I'm going to beat the crap out of you.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Umm...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Shut up! Think about what you'd do for me. I'll do just the same for you!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: And you'd better not forget it!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Also, you're not allowed to abandon me ever again.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Rus...

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: You know I'd never do that.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmph! Of course I know!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Alright, the fact that you're okay is a huge load off my shoulders... Now, I have something else to take care of. I promised Ratatos I'd finish another job after I save you.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: A job?

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior
steps.text: Madame Sciurus, Weiss of the Silverash clan is moving to intercept us!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Right on schedule. I'll tell you the details later, but our job is to cause some trouble for those Silverash bastards.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: And... there's someone else I want to talk to. But that comes later!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Things aren't looking too good, and Weiss won't go down easy... But we're in this together. Right, Yucatan?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Of course. I'll be there for you as long as you need me.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Close in on them!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Don't let Arctosz up the mountain path!

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Warrior
steps.text: Sir, we're about to be completely encircled!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hmph... I suppose this is as far as we could get just charging through.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Please lay down your arms, Arctosz.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Child of Yek, I don't know what Enciodes offered you to make you so infatuated with him.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The Yek family is prominent in Paleroche lands.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Yet you still chose to help Enciodes usurp Kjerag!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Lay down my arms?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Never.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Arrest Arctosz... But try to take him alive.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Come at me, Silverash scum! Who's brave enough to face me?!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ...Aurora?!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Does that mean––

options: Looks like I caught up to you.
(Tug on the brim of your hood)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Doctor––?!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Don't tell me, Degenbrecher...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Ah, Doctor, it's about damned time!

options: The snow delayed things a bit.
Avoiding Silverash eyes and ears took time.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Haha, Kjerag's snow is a challenge for outsiders like you.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: No worries. All that matters is that you're here!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Heh, now that reinforcements are here, nothing can stop us!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Isn't it too early to celebrate, Arctosz?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Enciodes!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Long time no see, Doctor.

options: Has it really been that long?
So, you're finally willing to meet me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Though there's a lot I want to talk to you about, now is not the time, unfortunately.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Just you wait, Enciodes. I'll break through your encirclement, rescue the Saintess, and prove to all of Kjerag that you're the real traitor!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I’m looking forward to it.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Warriors, what has been the house of Paleroche's duty since the beginning of time?
'Defend Kjerag from foreign enemies, and protect the peace of the land!'

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Now, Enciodes seeks to work against the Saintess and use her as his tool.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Can we, the hosue of Paleroche, accept that?
'No! No! Absolutely not!!!'

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Reinforcements have arrived. Follow me up Mount Karlan, topple Enciodes, and rescue the Saintess!
'Topple Enciodes, rescue the Saintess!'
'Topple Enciodes, rescue the Saintess!!'
'Topple Enciodes, rescue the Saintess!!!'

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: Saintess, what are you doing?!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I'm heading down the mountain.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: Sir Enciodes said––

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Since when do I need Enciodes's consent to do things?
'Ding ding', 'ding ding', 'ding ding––'
An otherworldly bell sounds throughout the court.
The next moment, everyone present except Ensia falls to the ground.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Wow... incredible...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjarr, Kjarr.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Saintess, how did you know I was here?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I can guess where a clever girl hides.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I need to make a trip down the mountain, so please look after things here.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Oh, are you leaving the hard work to me?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: There are even more troublesome things waiting for me.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: If that's the case, I suppose I can't object.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: In fact, during each Saintess selection, I'd dress up as a maid and secretly observe the girls being tested.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You were the sixth one that year.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I didn't have very high expectations for you, at first, since the Saintesses have been more and more boring as of late.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: They may have been strong of body, but none of them were sufficiently strong of will and all ended up puppets of the Elders.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I sometimes wonder if this is because Kjerag is too closed-off. They, and the people of this country too, stagnated.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: But you're different.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You're very interesting, Enya.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You didn't come here because you wanted to be the Saintess, but because of your anger and disappointment.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You faced the unforgiving elements on the trail up the mountain, you refused to give up even when your body had reached its limits, the thing on your mind...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Was not becoming a Saintess, or becoming an envoy of Kjeragandr. Rather, you were thinking about how best to serve the Kjerag people.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You thought about how disappointed you were in your brother, how disgusted you were with the other two clans, and the rage you felt at becoming the Saintess.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: But the real surprise was your attitude towards Kjerag.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Or more accurately, the surprise that your family brought me.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Your brother gave me his answer sheet very early on.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: And you have been searching for your own answers this entire time.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Over the years, you've endured the indifference with which the Saintess is treated in the Vine-Bead Court, while actively searching for a way to help the people. These things have become your nourishment.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: And now, all that nourishment has transformed into your strength. You have not lost yourself amidst the turmoil, and you have made your choice.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Congratulations, my child, my envoy, my friend, my sister.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Forgive me for not being able to guide you. I rashly branded this land with my mark, and still regret it to this day.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: But at least, allow me to add some color to your journey.
Above the silent passageway, Kjarr smiles and gently pats her hands together.
'Clap, clap.'
After which, everything changes.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Just a scratch!

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Valais, I'm not sure if Master Arctosz wronged you in some way––

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: But Enciodes isn't exactly a saint himself!

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: I already told you.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Kjerag needs change.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: This is also so that excellent warriors like yourself will no longer make sacrifices in vain!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Don't force my hand, Valais.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: That's my line, Gulo.
The two of them take a step back and assume a solid stance.
They know that today, one of them must fall.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: The dark cloud... cleared?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Gah... What a stubborn one. I underestimated you.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: But, even if you manage to defeat us here, it won't make any difference.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You cannot stop the Master.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Like I care.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: The Matriarch... Ratatos always had her own ideas about Kjerag.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: She also wants people to move forward and hopes that everyone can have a better future.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Except, she doesn't have the power.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: And so, she became Ratatos the schemer, as you people call her.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Maybe to you, my sister is just a bump in the road.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: But to me, she'll always be my beloved sister!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yucatan...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: We don't hold any personal grudges against you. As long as you're willing to lay down your arms, we guarantee your safety.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: I'm not going to let Rus and I become bargaining chips for Enciodes to use against the Matriarch.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Weiss of the Silverash clan, step aside, or I will kill you.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: The same goes for you, Yucatan of the Browntail clan.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You must remain here.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You can do it, Yucatan!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Look, Mount Karlan! Are those dark clouds clearing up?!
Sharp turns and watches Degenbrecher slowly return her swordbreakers to her waist.
Around them, trees lie snapped in twain and rocks shattered as if a Catastrophe swept through the land.
He doesn't notice his knife slipping, because he has already lost feeling in his right hand.
He has lost.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Best not overuse your right hand for the next three months.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Thanks for the tip. Looks like it's time to take a brief medical leave.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You don't seem very upset about it.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: The outcome of our fight here doesn't change anything.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I kept you occupied here until now, so I've done my job. The others will handle the rest.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Now that my job's done, it's time to clock out.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Is your job that important to you?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Maintaining professionalism is very important to me.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Finding a good employer isn't easy, so I do happen to care about this job.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: What about you? You knew from the beginning that I was here to waste your time. You don't look that upset about it.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Call it a bit of curiosity. Even if you managed to delay me here, what exactly can you accomplish?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Looks like, Enciodes's bodyguards are good for doing more than just his dirty work.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: People only know that Enciodes bought The Black Knight. They don't know the Black Knight also approves of Enciodes.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: You and Enciodes are both prideful.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...I'll remember your name, Sharp.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: You don't have to remember my name, but you would do well to remember the Doctor's.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: What's going on at Mount Karlan?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Soldiers, in formation.

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Warriors
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: All forces––

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What happened?
Time seems to stand still in this moment.
Only the Saintess's footsteps reverberate through the mountains.
The wind and snow already gave way, at some unknown time.
The dark clouds overhead seem to part before her path, slowly spreading to both sides.
The light filtering through the clouds shines upon the Saintess, and for a second, the people see her descending from the sky itself.
But this is no illusion.
A miracle...
It's a miracle.
It's a miracle!!!
In this moment, only one thought remains in the hearts of the warriors.
And that is –– to offer their staunchest devotion to the Saintess.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Kjarr.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Go. I will attend to the Great Elder.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Come to think of it, even though the great hall has been repaired several times, it may not be much younger than Her.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: The same goes for the title of Great Elder.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: No one would deny that the existence of the Vine-Bead Court has allowed Kjerag to remain united all these years.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: But what was correct in the past may no longer be correct.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: If you cannot adapt to the changing times, then no matter how strong you are, you are fated to be cast aside.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Kjerag should not suffer that fate. At least, that is what some people hope.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Sweet dreams, Great Elder.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You've done well. You've all done well.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: ...How?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: ...What is THAT?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Is that... a miracle...?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: What's going on at Mount Karlan?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: All forces, pull back.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What... just happened?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Can it be... a miracle from Kjeragandr?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What will happen to Kjerag now...?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Hurts my eyes.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You've got me wondering now. Is this also a part of your Doctor's plans?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I don't know myself.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: To be honest, if this was a part of the Doctor's plans, or even an anticipated possibility...

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Even if some operators act like the Doctor is omnipotent, I think this would be a bridge too far.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Enya, I'm scared...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Don't be, Ensia.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I will protect you.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I... will protect Kjerag.
All the warriors along the mountain trail lay their weapons down.
In the face of a miracle from the Goddess of the Snowy Mountains, the goddess they have worshipped all their lives, their mortal squabbles seem ridiculous.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I, leader of the Paleroche clan, Arctosz Paleroche, offer my most sincere blessings to Her envoy, the Saintess.
After a short silence, he slowly bows to the Saintess and kneels before her.
All the Paleroche warriors follow his lead, repeating his actions.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...Having second thoughts now, Enciodes?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You ignored my advice and brought that Doctor to Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Do you think we lost?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Does this not seem like a loss to you?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It might have, in the past.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But today... maybe not.
Enciodes steps forward.
He strides out from the crowd and also approaches the Saintess, taking a knee and offering his blessings.
All the warriors of the Silverash clan follow suit.
And thus, the Snowcap Incident comes to an unexpected conclusion.
